== Notes ==
*Can be used to fuel skills that will drain all adrenaline anyway, such as [[Decapitate]] or [[Final Thrust]].
*Synergizes well with [[Warrior's Endurance]] (in [[PvE]]) and an energy-only [[skill bar]].
*If reapplied before it expires (for example with [[Dwarven Stability]]), adrenaline is still lost, since applying a stance always ends the previous one.

== Trivia ==
* The warrior in the [[skill icon]] is wearing [[Warrior Sunspear armor|Sunspear armor]].
